messages.author: Unknown Identity
messages.text:
My idea is to recommend adding a war budget, make maintaining an army a costly investment. Instead of just using rations to recruit troops and feed them. Now i want to add the ability to pay them on an hourly basis, same for ships, planes and missiles, they should cost money not just resources to maintain and upkeep. 

If this suggestion seems likely to pass, I will use my experience in the US military to figure out realistic costs and apply them here for dede to implement.
